# Zeus UI

Pick every element. See it live. Your agent builds exactly that. Free, live UI components and a Studio for people who build with coding agents.

- [Agent manifest](https://myzeusui.com/agents.json): 210 components and templates with examples and install commands.
- [Registry](https://myzeusui.com/r/registry.json)
- [Styles](https://myzeusui.com/styles/)
- [Setup for agents](https://myzeusui.com/agents/)

## Install

- Source: `npx --yes --allow-remote=all --package=https://myzeusui.com/install/zeus-ui-0.4.0.tgz zeus-ui add <name>` copies the source, its dependencies and styles into your React project.
- shadcn: `npx shadcn@latest add https://myzeusui.com/r/<name>.json`
- MCP: `claude mcp add zeus -- npx --yes --allow-remote=all --package=https://myzeusui.com/install/zeus-mcp-0.4.0.tgz zeus-mcp`

## Components

- [Controls](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-controls/): Shared controls, scoped overlays and motion primitives
- [Balance card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-balance-card/): A compact balance card with a framed account panel, overlapping account marks, large numeric hierarchy, and a shared two-action footer
- [Compact card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-compact-card/): A compact generic card with a layered textured backdrop, status, overlapping people, flexible details, supporting context, and a focused action
- [Invite card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-invite-card/): A referral invite card with reward artwork, a concise three-step explainer, dismiss behavior, and a copyable personal link
- [Folder card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-folder-card/): A near-square collection card with a full-bleed media layer, a continuous folder-shaped content surface, and anchored metadata
- [Story card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-story-card/): A tall editorial story card with category and date markers, concise narrative copy, and a location-aware image treatment
- [Profile card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-profile-card/): A compact professional profile card with live availability, avatar-led identity, focused contact actions, and a layered status tray
- [Text swap](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-text-swap/): A fixed-footprint hover label where alternating letters roll in opposite directions through a short motion blur
- [Text highlight](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-text-highlight/): Animated text highlights in looping and progressive layouts, with coordinated colour, blur and position transitions
- [Morphic tooltip](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-morphic-tooltip/): A shared-layout tooltip primitive with one animated surface that morphs between triggers for polished hover and focus hints
- [Morphic command palette](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-morphic-command-palette/): A simple search field and grouped command list, with smooth resizing as results change and one animated selection highlight
- [Agent chat input](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-agent-chat-input/): A prompt box for agents in four layouts, from a spacious creative composer to a compact pill, with attachments, model selection and submit states
- [Voice agent](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-voice-agent/): A voice assistant in session and dock layouts, with an animated orb, connection states and microphone controls
- [Data table](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-data-table/): A searchable data table in responsive, compact and paginated layouts, with sorting, filters and row actions
- [Stacked bar chart](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-stacked-bar-chart/): Stacked bars over time that grow from the baseline, with a tooltip that glides beside the active bar, reference lines, projected bars, series toggles, and arrow-key navigation
- [Segmented meter](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-segmented-meter/): A capacity meter split into colored segments, with a gliding tooltip, a linked legend, selection, and hover state you can share with tables or lists
- [Sparkline](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-sparkline/): A compact trend line that draws in from the left and renders correctly before hydration
- [Flip card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-flip-card/): An image card that flips inline or opens a detail dialog, with keyboard focus and motion states
- [Animated dropdown](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-animated-dropdown/): Four dropdown compositions demonstrating the shared animated focus surface across pointer and keyboard navigation, controlled selection, text triggers, and nested states
- [Animated modal](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-animated-modal/): Compose a focused dialog with the shared inputs and buttons, keyboard dismissal, and automatic focus restoration
- [Audit trail](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-audit-trail/): See who changed what, narrow the history by category or actor, and inspect recorded values in an animated modal
- [Approval queue](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-approval-queue/): Review pending requests, approve or decline with a note, request changes, and keep completed reviews available for reference
- [Log explorer](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-log-explorer/): Inspect a live log stream with counted severity tabs, searchable entries, frozen pause snapshots, and copyable inline payloads
- [Notification center](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-notification-center/): Notifications in dropdown and panel layouts, with filtering, read status, item actions and detail views
- [Voice conversation](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-voice-conversation/): Controlled listening, thinking, speaking, and connection states. Connect the audio level, transcript, and callbacks to your voice service
- [File upload](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-file-upload/): A dropzone that reacts to dragged files, accepts paste and browsing, validates type and size, and tracks each upload with progress, speed, pause, retry, image previews, and a rolling summary
- [What's new](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-whats-new/): A corner teaser with stacked thumbnails opens a release dialog with one feature per slide: drifting media or custom animated media, highlights, a try-it action, step dots, swipe and arrow-key navigation, and a finish step that links to the full changelog
- [Usage budget](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-usage-budget/): A segmented usage meter with resource costs, animated totals, and an adjustable monthly budget
- [Research sources](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-research-sources/): A searchable reference library with source filters, readable excerpts, and context selection
- [Conversion funnel](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-conversion-funnel/): Explore conversion stages with an interactive Recharts chart, period controls, and drop-off details
- [Model picker](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-model-picker/): A searchable model selector in grouped and provider-rail layouts, with keyboard navigation and animated selection
- [Code artifact](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-code-artifact/): A compact code artifact using the public Artemis agent code renderer, with syntax highlighting, line numbers, copy, and download
- [Document artifact](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-document-artifact/): Preview and edit a document, revisit saved versions, copy content, and download Markdown
- [AI thinking loader](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-ai-thinking-loader/): Six animated status indicators for an assistant that is processing a request, with reduced-motion support
- [What we offer](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-what-we-offer/): Three feature sections combining service descriptions, illustrated panels and calls to action in different layouts
- [Empty states](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-empty-states/): Four illustrated empty states for archives, search, inboxes and project boards, with contextual actions
- [Morphic card modal](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-morphic-card-modal/): Apple-style card expansion modal. A card morphs into a full overlay using shared layout animation — no position hacks, just framer layoutId
- [Blog sections](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-blog-sections/): Article collections in image-card, featured-story, list and compact-card layouts, with category filters where applicable
- [Announcement banners](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-announcement-banners/): Announcements in gradient, shader, rotating-ribbon and stacked-card layouts, with dismissal and navigation controls
- [App showcase](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-app-showcase/): A phone floating on a mesh-gradient shader stage, flanked by four features. Photo-rich screens slide in from the direction of travel and play their own detail motion, teammate activity pops beside the device, and the phone tilts toward the pointer. Auto-advance pauses on hover, focus, and when off screen
- [Product tour](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-product-tour/): A scroll-driven product tour with pinned artwork and chapter navigation.
- [How it works](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-how-it-works/): Process sections in five layouts with steps, demonstrations and animated transitions.

- [Select](https://myzeusui.com/elements/select/): Single-choice listbox whose items take free-form content — dots, avatars, icons.

- [Dropdown](https://myzeusui.com/elements/dropdown/): Composable menu primitives — trigger, popover, groups, items and dividers.
- [Divider](https://myzeusui.com/elements/divider/): Single, double and filled separators that can carry any content in the middle.

- [Table](https://myzeusui.com/elements/table/): The semantic table primitive: sortable columns, row selection, two densities.
- [Textarea](https://myzeusui.com/elements/textarea/): A reusable multiline field with matching labels, hints, count, bounded auto growth and native event/ref support
- [Tree View](https://myzeusui.com/elements/tree-view/): An accessible file tree with controlled collections, selection, keyboard navigation, logical guides and animated expansion
- [Tooltip](https://myzeusui.com/elements/tooltip/): Hover and focus tooltip with the arrow and placement handled for you.
- [Badge](https://myzeusui.com/elements/badge/): Count pills for nav rows and menus, in neutral and primary.
- [Chip](https://myzeusui.com/elements/chip/): Bold, subtle and caption tones across nine colours, for deltas, values and tags.
- [Status Dot](https://myzeusui.com/elements/status-dot/): The small coloured dot that prefixes a status label.
- [Kbd](https://myzeusui.com/elements/kbd/): Keyboard key caps for shortcut hints.
- [Avatar](https://myzeusui.com/elements/avatar/): Photo or initials avatar, four sizes and semantic colour tints.
- [Breadcrumb](https://myzeusui.com/elements/breadcrumb/): Path trail whose items take arbitrary leading content — avatars, icons, dots.
- [Pagination](https://myzeusui.com/elements/pagination/): Page numbers with truncation and prev/next controls.
- [Carousel](https://myzeusui.com/elements/carousel/): Snap track with arrows, dots, configurable gap and alignment.
- [Announcement](https://myzeusui.com/elements/announcement/): Dismissible banner for product news, with an optional action.
- [Notification](https://myzeusui.com/elements/notification/): Toast with status, icon or avatar, timestamp, actions and auto-dismiss.
- [Date Picker](https://myzeusui.com/elements/date-picker/): Popover calendar for a single date, built on @internationalized/date.
- [Date Range Picker](https://myzeusui.com/elements/date-range-picker/): Two-month range picker with quick presets and an apply step.
- [Meeting Scheduler](https://myzeusui.com/elements/meeting-scheduler/): A booking panel: host, duration, timezone, date and time slots.
- [Theme Toggle](https://myzeusui.com/elements/theme-toggle/): Light/dark switch that reveals the next theme from the exact click point.
- [Stat Cards](https://myzeusui.com/elements/stat-cards/): KPI row with gradient icon tiles, info tooltips and delta pills, in two variants.
- [Data Grid](https://myzeusui.com/elements/data-grid/): A virtual spreadsheet with typed editors, cell ranges, search, filters, resizing, summaries, clipboard transactions and undo
- [Data Table](https://myzeusui.com/elements/data-table/): TanStack Table with sorting, selection, filters, search, density and pagination.
- [Sidebar](https://myzeusui.com/elements/sidebar/): The 260px dashboard sidebar with collapsing nav, team switcher and user menu.
- [App Shell](https://myzeusui.com/elements/app-shell/): The page frame: sidebar, mobile drawer, breadcrumb header and content column.
- [Notification Center](https://myzeusui.com/elements/notification-center/): Grouped, filterable inbox with unread state and per-item actions.
- [Settings Modal](https://myzeusui.com/elements/settings-modal/): Five-page settings dialog: profile, general, tools, storage and plan.
- [Auth Card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/auth-card/): Sign in, sign up and verify, with stacked, inline and grid provider layouts.
- [Agent Limits](https://myzeusui.com/elements/agent-limits-card/): Context window usage as a segmented bar with an expandable token breakdown, plus plan quotas and their reset times.
- [Agent Thinking](https://myzeusui.com/elements/agent-thinking/): Four loading personalities — wave, spin, stars and infinity — with an elapsed timer.
- [Composer Loader](https://myzeusui.com/elements/composer-loader/): A travelling light that rims the composer while an agent is answering.
- [Agent Log](https://myzeusui.com/elements/agent-log/): The primitives behind a streaming tool log: reveal masks, guides and shimmer text.
- [Agent Chat](https://myzeusui.com/elements/agent-chat/): A working chat app: thread history, streaming messages, composer and suggestions.
- [Area Chart](https://myzeusui.com/elements/area-chart-card/): One or more series as soft filled bands, stacked into a total by default.
- [Line Chart](https://myzeusui.com/elements/line-chart-card/): Several series compared over one axis, smooth or sharp, with a dashed comparison.
- [Bar List](https://myzeusui.com/elements/bar-list-card/): A ranked list where each row's bar is its share of the top — no axis, no library.
- [Activity Rings](https://myzeusui.com/elements/activity-rings-card/): Concentric progress arcs, one per goal, drawn as plain SVG.
- [Chart Card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/chart-card/): The shared frame every chart card is built on: header, count-up headline, delta chip and legend.
- [Revenue Chart](https://myzeusui.com/elements/revenue-chart-card/): Year-over-year area chart with a computed headline and delta.
- [Orders Chart](https://myzeusui.com/elements/orders-chart-card/): Year-over-year bars with the same headline and delta treatment.
- [Important Alerts](https://myzeusui.com/elements/important-alerts-card/): A dated alert feed with severity icons and a week range pill.
- [Patient Info](https://myzeusui.com/elements/patient-info-card/): A profile card with identity fields and vitals.
- [Floating Sidebar](https://myzeusui.com/elements/floating-sidebar/): An inset navigation panel with layered depth and tinted active rows.
